An individual was the '''pilot''' of the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Juliupper]]''.<ref name="VP" /> In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]'' to [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].</ref> the ''Juliupper'' attempted to evacuate the inhabitants of the<ref name="VP" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} — Based on corresponding data for [[Julevian system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]], which had been [[Destruction of Sernpidal|destroyed]] after the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] pulled the planet's [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dobido]] into the planet.. However, Yuuzhan Vong [[grutchin]]s, [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] creatures that tore through [[Starship/Legends|starships]], attacked the ''Juliupper''{{'s}} [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engines]]. The shuttle's [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] called for assistance, but the grutchins destroyed the ''Juliupper'' before it could receive any.<ref name="VP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The pilot's voice first appeared in the [[1999]] novel [[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime|''Vector Prime'']], written by [[R. A. Salvatore]] as the first volume in the ''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order]]'' novel series.<ref name="VP" />
